meta.description: As you return your displaced emotions to their rightful place, the wheel of destiny begins to turn and the truth is gradually revealed.

units.rawText: Professor...
units.displayText: Professor...

spans.text: Professor...

units.rawText: Persicaria. How are you and Sangoma recovering?
units.displayText: Persicaria. How are you and Sangoma recovering?

spans.text: Persicaria. How are you and Sangoma recovering?

units.rawText: Mada- Ahem... I mean, Sangoma's treatments are very effective. I've mostly recovered through her healing.

units.rawText: Ah, you're looking at the activation records...
units.displayText: Ah, you're looking at the activation records...

units.rawText: Mm-hmm. After realizing Eosphorus' influence on my memory, I've begun to form another theory about that conflicting memory.

units.rawText: Sangoma, may I ask you a question?
units.displayText: Sangoma, may I ask you a question?

spans.text: Sangoma, may I ask you a question?

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: I close my eyes, trying to replay the scene when I was asked that question.
units.displayText: I close my eyes, trying to replay the scene when I was asked that question.

spans.text: I close my eyes, trying to replay the scene when I was asked that question.

units.rawText: "What are you?"
units.displayText: "What are you?"

spans.text: "What are you?"

units.rawText: "You, who was born in this world—are you a human, an angel, or God?"
units.displayText: "You, who was born in this world—are you a human, an angel, or God?"

spans.text: "You, who was born in this world—are you a human, an angel, or God?"

units.rawText: Sangoma, in my memories, you once asked me about this. Do you remember doing so?
units.displayText: Sangoma, in my memories, you once asked me about this. Do you remember doing so?

spans.text: Sangoma, in my memories, you once asked me about this. Do you remember doing so?

units.rawText: Sangoma rubs her chin in deep thought. Shortly after, she softly shakes her head.
units.displayText: Sangoma rubs her chin in deep thought. Shortly after, she softly shakes her head.

spans.text: Sangoma rubs her chin in deep thought. Shortly after, she softly shakes her head.

units.rawText: ...I don't remember doing so. Are you sure it was me who asked this question?
units.displayText: ...I don't remember doing so. Are you sure it was me who asked this question?

spans.text: ...I don't remember doing so. Are you sure it was me who asked this question?

units.rawText: Just as I thought... the voice I heard wasn't yours.
units.displayText: Just as I thought... the voice I heard wasn't yours.

spans.text: Just as I thought... the voice I heard wasn't yours.

units.rawText: Hm? Voice? What voice?
units.displayText: Hm? Voice? What voice?

spans.text: Hm? Voice? What voice?

units.rawText: When I was first uploaded to the Cloud, someone whispered that question to me in the darkness, before my sensory system had fully become online.
units.displayText: When I was first uploaded to the Cloud, someone whispered that question to me in the darkness, before my sensory system had fully become online.

spans.text: When I was first uploaded to the Cloud, someone whispered that question to me in the darkness, before my sensory system had fully become online.

units.rawText: I thought the one who questioned me was you or some hallucination, but now I know I was so very wrong...
units.displayText: I thought the one who questioned me was you or some hallucination, but now I know I was so very wrong...

spans.text: I thought the one who questioned me was you or some hallucination, but now I know I was so very wrong...

units.rawText: (Some say that God is born of conviction.)
units.displayText: Some say that God is born of conviction.

spans.text: Some say that God is born of conviction.

units.rawText: ...Are you suggesting that God could be anyone?
units.displayText: ...Are you suggesting that God could be anyone?

spans.text: ...Are you suggesting that God could be anyone?

units.rawText: (More like, anyone can become God... though that's just my limited view on divinity.)
units.displayText: More like, anyone can become God... though that's just my limited view on divinity.

units.rawText: Now is not the time you get to know me.
units.displayText: Now is not the time you get to know me.

spans.text: Now is not the time you get to know me.

units.displayText: Your sensory system isn't fully online yet. Premature contact could lead to unwanted complications.

units.rawText: (Complications? What do you mean...)
units.displayText: Complications? What do you mean...

spans.text: Complications? What do you mean...

units.rawText: Shhh... Keep quiet.
units.displayText: Shhh... Keep quiet.

spans.text: Shhh... Keep quiet.

units.rawText: ...The pests are coming.
units.displayText: ...The pests are coming.

spans.text: ...The pests are coming.

units.rawText: ...Come to think of it, that question was very much Eosphorus' style.
units.displayText: ...Come to think of it, that question was very much Eosphorus' style.

spans.text: ...Come to think of it, that question was very much Eosphorus' style.

units.rawText: What Eosphorus referred to as "pests" wasn't the Lesser Sanctifiers, rather, it was you. He sent the Lesser Sanctifiers there to hide traces of his involvement.
units.displayText: What Eosphorus referred to as "pests" wasn't the Lesser Sanctifiers, rather, it was you. He sent the Lesser Sanctifiers there to hide traces of his involvement.

spans.text: What Eosphorus referred to as "pests" wasn't the Lesser Sanctifiers, rather, it was you. He sent the Lesser Sanctifiers there to hide traces of his involvement.

units.rawText: So what you're saying is he was silently observing us from somewhere while you and I were breaking out of the Lesser Sanctifiers' encirclement?
units.displayText: So what you're saying is he was silently observing us from somewhere while you and I were breaking out of the Lesser Sanctifiers' encirclement?

spans.text: So what you're saying is he was silently observing us from somewhere while you and I were breaking out of the Lesser Sanctifiers' encirclement?

units.rawText: Yes. And that's how he was able to disguise himself with your form, and made contact with me later.
units.displayText: Yes. And that's how he was able to disguise himself with your form, and made contact with me later.

spans.text: Yes. And that's how he was able to disguise himself with your form, and made contact with me later.

units.rawText: The way I stayed so secretive gave him the chance... Do you remember what Eosphorus said to you while he was in my form?
units.displayText: The way I stayed so secretive gave him the chance... Do you remember what Eosphorus said to you while he was in my form?

spans.text: The way I stayed so secretive gave him the chance... Do you remember what Eosphorus said to you while he was in my form?

units.rawText: We had three significant encounters.
units.displayText: We had three significant encounters.

spans.text: We had three significant encounters.

units.rawText: First, it was the time I was scouting Oasis' surrounding areas.
units.displayText: First, it was the time I was scouting Oasis' surrounding areas.

spans.text: First, it was the time I was scouting Oasis' surrounding areas.

units.rawText: <cmdr>, have you considered the idea of forming relationships with other sectors?
units.displayText: {교수}, have you considered the idea of forming relationships with other sectors?

spans.text: , have you considered the idea of forming relationships with other sectors?

units.rawText: I've considered that, but the Oasis still doesn't have enough military strength. Reaching out to other sectors could create unnecessary risks, and we must plan thoroughly before we act.
units.displayText: I've considered that, but the Oasis still doesn't have enough military strength. Reaching out to other sectors could create unnecessary risks, and we must plan thoroughly before we act.

spans.text: I've considered that, but the Oasis still doesn't have enough military strength. Reaching out to other sectors could create unnecessary risks, and we must plan thoroughly before we act.

units.rawText: On the flip side, I'm not sure if involving the locals in our struggles is the right thing to do... It's in our best interest to keep everything as peaceful as can be, like we are now.
units.displayText: On the flip side, I'm not sure if involving the locals in our struggles is the right thing to do... It's in our best interest to keep everything as peaceful as can be, like we are now.

spans.text: On the flip side, I'm not sure if involving the locals in our struggles is the right thing to do... It's in our best interest to keep everything as peaceful as can be, like we are now.

units.rawText: I see...
units.displayText: I see...

spans.text: I see...

units.rawText: ...But the truth is, Magrasea descended into turmoil long ago, and its current state is far removed from peace.
units.displayText: ...But the truth is, Magrasea descended into turmoil long ago, and its current state is far removed from peace.

spans.text: ...But the truth is, Magrasea descended into turmoil long ago, and its current state is far removed from peace.

units.rawText: He suggested that I form relationships with other sectors... But I rejected it.
units.displayText: He suggested that I form relationships with other sectors... But I rejected it.

spans.text: He suggested that I form relationships with other sectors... But I rejected it.

units.rawText: Considering what Eosphorus was leading us into, it looks like he wanted to use us to initialize other sectors' Sandbox Barriers to aid in the Entropic invasion later.

units.rawText: I think so too.

units.rawText: The second contact was near the Pierides Sector while I was searching for resources. He always chose to make contact while I was out in the field, likely wary of exposing his signature by entering the Oasis.
units.displayText: The second contact was near the Pierides Sector while I was searching for resources. He always chose to make contact while I was out in the field, likely wary of exposing his signature by entering the Oasis.

units.rawText: <cmdr>, since we're already here, why don't we check out that place?

units.rawText: The Pierides Sector... I didn't realize I had gotten this close.
units.displayText: The Pierides Sector... I didn't realize I had gotten this close.

spans.text: The Pierides Sector... I didn't realize I had gotten this close.

units.rawText: The Pierides Sector should have plenty of operands in reserve to help with the Oasis' shortage. If we can't figure out the Sanctifiers' plans for now, we might as well try something new.
units.displayText: The Pierides Sector should have plenty of operands in reserve to help with the Oasis' shortage. If we can't figure out the Sanctifiers' plans for now, we might as well try something new.

spans.text: The Pierides Sector should have plenty of operands in reserve to help with the Oasis' shortage. If we can't figure out the Sanctifiers' plans for now, we might as well try something new.

units.rawText: Why don't we go check it out? I'll cover your escape if there's any danger.
units.displayText: Why don't we go check it out? I'll cover your escape if there's any danger.

spans.text: Why don't we go check it out? I'll cover your escape if there's any danger.

units.rawText: Acquiring resources from other sectors... That's a good train of thought, but we'll hold off on it for now.
units.displayText: Acquiring resources from other sectors... That's a good train of thought, but we'll hold off on it for now.

spans.text: Acquiring resources from other sectors... That's a good train of thought, but we'll hold off on it for now.

units.rawText: Today's fieldwork uncovered a new resource deposit, enough to address our supply concerns for the time being. Now, I must regroup with Sol soon, and analyze Sanctifiers' abnormal behavior when we get back.
units.displayText: Today's fieldwork uncovered a new resource deposit, enough to address our supply concerns for the time being. Now, I must regroup with Sol soon, and analyze Sanctifiers' abnormal behavior when we get back.

units.rawText: ...Fine. But Pierides should be a good option if you're going to form relationships with other sectors.
units.displayText: ...Fine. But Pierides should be a good option if you're going to form relationships with other sectors.

spans.text: ...Fine. But Pierides should be a good option if you're going to form relationships with other sectors.

units.rawText: The Pierides Sector... It later became a den of Entropics, claiming the lives of Odile and Odette.

spans.text: The Pierides Sector... It later became a den of Entropics, claiming the lives of Odile and Odette.

spans.text: At the time he met me, he probably had fixed his eyes on the Pierides Sector, planning to use it as his testing ground for Entropics.

units.rawText: Eosphorus had arranged the Lesser Sanctifier assault to redirect your movements, but you didn't take the bait. Then, Eosphorus had to do it with brute force.

units.rawText: ...Yes. He directed the Sanctifier attack on the Oasis.
units.displayText: ...Yes. He directed the Sanctifier attack on the Oasis.

spans.text: ...Yes. He directed the Sanctifier attack on the Oasis.

units.rawText: Before the assault, he disguised himself as Sangoma and discussed with me about the Oasis' defenses and the Sandbox Barrier's mechanisms, and that's the third contact.

units.rawText: That's why the Sanctifiers knew precisely where our HQ and core structures were... the commander behind the assault was Eosphorus.

spans.text: That's why the Sanctifiers knew precisely where our HQ and core structures were... the commander behind the assault was Eosphorus.

units.rawText: I'm afraid so. Although we force-restarted Oasis' core systems, eventually defeating them, he also adapted his plan and stole a part of my memory fragment, planting it in the Entropic program here.

units.displayText: Eosphorus...

units.displayText: Yes.
